Normal fresh registration/city bootstrap and exactly one template 1017 recruitment with starter item 2004. No fixture or gold seed; no Begin/Finish/Cancel/Faster/Upgrade. Original screenshots and DOM ancestor rect/overflow/clipping/hit samples precede a bounded trial-only row-center check; the trial sends no click but may scroll. Visual review must distinguish an unreachable layout from an unsuitable QA click target. This is not training acceptance.

Reports preserve safe full outbound route sequence and hero mutation payloads/results, no authentication payloads/tokens/trace IDs. An explicit route allowlist rejects extra mutations, with exactly one Register/CreateCity/RecruitHero. Read-only PG snapshots verify original and post-click hero/EXP/status/session/item invariants and exact wallet costs plus natural 120-food/hour production. Unfolded, each-fold and final screenshots/geometry and original sanitized errors remain artifacts on failure.

Run `node .github/scripts/live_hero_reachability.mjs --self-test` for browser-free geometry/redaction checks. Official browser execution is bounded to five minutes within a 20-minute job and never retries a mutation. Cleanup records owned PID/name/liveness/requested SIGTERM; only asserted Vite 6.4.5 preview may return 143/null following its successful requested shutdown. Earlier/nonzero/signal/forced/live exits fail. Exact source pins, tests, logs, reports and both viewport artifacts require independent review; runner loss can prevent upload and never implies PASS.
